h:
我的新图像生成工作流程。旨在允许多种不同风格的图像，只需更改文本提示。这是 Flux.1 D 的初始版本，在 ComfyUI 中进行了 SDXL 升级和细化，并在 Forge 中进行了最终的 img2img 细化。 5060 Ti 上的 ComfyUI 中的初始图像生成和细化大约需要 56 秒，3060 Ti 上的 Forge 中的最终细化过程只需一分多钟。如果有人有任何建议，请告诉我。谢谢

附言。 Cyber​​Realistic V 1.0 用于初始 Flux 通道，IntoRealismUltra Amateur 4.0 用于第二次和第三次 SDXL 通道。

o.en:
My new image generation workflow. Designed to allow for many varied styles of images with only changing the text prompts. This is a Flux.1 D initial generation, with a SDXL Upscale and refinement, both in ComfyUI and a final img2img refinement pass in Forge. Initial image generation and refinement in ComfyUI on a 5060 Ti takes about 56 seconds and the final refinement pass in Forge, on a 3060 Ti takes just over a minute. If anyone has any suggestions, let me know. Thanks

PS. CyberRealistic V 1.0 for initial Flux pass and IntoRealismUltra Amateur 4.0 for second and third SDXL passes.
